scope: Focused continuation of audit release readiness; concrete counterexamples reproduced before repairs. Original audit and0.9.0 evidence are unchanged.

fixes.problem: Global annotation stripping removed meaningful property names and literal instance fields before comparison, permitting conflicting contracts to compare equal.
fixes.result: Context-aware structural comparison preserves map keys, literals and opaque schema vocabulary; resolver and artifact checks share one policy. Normative reference traversal also preserves literal $ref keys in instance data and property-name maps; real external contract references remain blocked.

fixes.problem: Reference siblings were overlaid in both OpenAPI3.0 and3.1, potentially overriding rather than retaining referenced constraints.
fixes.result: OAS3.0 Reference Object siblings ignored; OAS3.1 schema siblings retained conjunctively as allOf. Offline reference and depth bounds preserved.
fixes.limitation: Conservative structural comparison, not arbitrary JSON Schema logical equivalence.

fixes.problem: Dependency-free requests and rehashed plans did not fully validate shape/version; missing content could mean deletion; later file preconditions could fail after earlier writes.
fixes.result: Fixed-schema core request validation, complete bounded/versioned/unique plan preflight, explicit deletion intent and all file preconditions checked before source mutation. Positive stdlib multi-file apply also tested.

fixes.problem: os.walk could silently omit an unreadable subtree and return a purported complete source identity.
fixes.result: Unreadable enumeration fails closed; no complete identity asserted from a partial walk.

unchanged_limits: Plugin Creator/marketplace tools not exposed; repository push does not publish installed plugin.
Real Mermaid render blocked by host browser administrator policy; no policy bypass attempted.
Live model comparisons and consenting user outcomes remain unmeasured.
Hosted collaboration/universal semantic services/autonomous multi-model expansion remain deferred as recommended.
Local adapter is a cooperating runner, not an OS/filesystem/network sandbox.

regression_evidence.initial_failures: Contract comparison:12 failing subtests across7 initial methods; adapter readiness:14 failing subtests and1 error across8 initial methods. Additional positive/edge cases added after repair.
regression_evidence.additional_reproductions: Five reference-traversal failures across four added methods were reproduced before the context-aware walk repair. A further installed full-schema success case verifies literal reference-looking data remains offline.
